title: StellarStudio 9.1.0 macOS installation
content:
Hello,

The StellarStudio 9.1.0 release notes state that StellarStudio is available for Windows, Linux and macOS.

However, the download page only provides:

StellarStudio-FULL-SR5-9.1.0.exe

I am trying to install StellarStudio natively on macOS (Intel).

I installed Eclipse 2026-06 and added the update sites

  • https://common.srxstudio.org
  • https://contrib.srxstudio.org
  • https://sr5.srxstudio.org

Eclipse finds the StellarStudio features, but installation fails because required bundles such as

  • org.eclipse.emf.ecp.core
  • org.eclipse.nebula.widgets.pgroup

cannot be resolved.

Could you please clarify:

  1. Is there a native macOS installer (.dmg or .pkg) for StellarStudio 9.1.0?
  2. If StellarStudio is intended to be installed into a standard Eclipse installation, which Eclipse package and prerequisite repositories are required?
  3. If not, where can the official macOS installation package be downloaded?
